description: Give a team its workspace folder, shared by all members: a new one by default, or with folderId an existing team folder from circles_list_linkable_folders. Needs Nextcloud 35, a team folder provider such as Team folders (groupfolders), and the team owner or a server admin.

folderId.description: Link this existing team folder instead of creating one

name.description: New folder name (default: the team name)

name: circles_create_workspace
title: Create Team Workspace
